name: Glitter Scientific Network Workbench
description: A searchable evidence workbench with an explorable pathogen-genomics resource graph.

layout.desktop: 56px application bar; 58px search; 238px filters; fluid results or graph; 340px inspector; 29px status line
layout.mobile: global search, off-canvas filters, stacked results or 68dvh graph, fixed bottom inspector

principles: Search and faceted resource results are the primary interface.
The graph is a peer view of the same filtered records.
Selection isolates one-hop context and reveals directed predicate labels.
Provenance and licensing remain attached to imported records.
Metadata relationships and verified assertions are visually distinct.
